stopPoints.label: Peppa waits by the window for her best friend Suzy Sheep
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story): 'Peppa is looking out the window. Who is she waiting for?'
Options: 'A) Her best friend Suzy Sheep 🐑 B) Danny Dog 🐶'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'She is waiting for Suzy Sheep!'

stopPoints.label: Suzy arrives and the best friends hold hands happily
stopPoints.question:
Question (Friendship): 'Suzy has arrived! Are Peppa and Suzy best friends?'
Options: 'A) Yes, they are! B) No, they aren't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they are best friends!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and Suzy tidy the toys to make room for big girl games
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story): 'Peppa and Suzy want to play on their own. Where did Mummy Pig tell them to go?'
Options: 'A) In Peppa's bedroom 🛏️ B) In the garden 🌳'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Go play in the bedroom!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa tells George this game is only for big girls
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'Peppa says this game is just for big girls. How does George feel?'
Options: 'A) He feels sad and left out 😢 B) He feels happy 😊'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'George feels sad.'

stopPoints.label: Fairy Princess Peppa casts a magic spell on Suzy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pretend Play): 'Peppa is a fairy princess! What does she turn Suzy into with her magic wand?'
Options: 'A) A little green frog 🐸 B) A princess 👑'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Turn you into a frog! Ribbit!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig calls George to help make chocolate chip cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story): 'George feels lonely downstairs. What yummy treat is Mummy Pig baking?'
Options: 'A) Chocolate chip cookies 🍪 B) Vegetable soup 🍲'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Making chocolate chip cookies!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and Suzy need a sick person for doctors and nurses
stopPoints.question:
Question (Role Play): 'Suzy is a nurse and Peppa is a doctor. Who do they need to find?'
Options: 'A) A sick person / patient 🤒 B) A bus driver 🚌'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'They need a sick person!'

stopPoints.label: Doctor Peppa listens to patient George's chest
stopPoints.question:
Question (Checkup): 'Doctor Peppa listens to George's chest. What does she tell George to do?'
Options: 'A) Take a big breath and cough 😷 B) Sing a song 🎵'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Take a breath and cough!'

stopPoints.label: Nurse Suzy checks George's temperature with a thermometer
stopPoints.question:
Question (Health): 'Nurse Suzy reads the thermometer! How does George feel?'
Options: 'A) Very, very hot 🔥 B) Very cold ❄️'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'He is very, very hot!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig visits patient George in bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story): 'Daddy Pig comes upstairs to visit. Is George really sick, or is it just a game?'
Options: 'A) It is only a game! 🎮 B) He is really sick 🏥'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It's only a game!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig brings sweet cookies as medicine for George
stopPoints.question:
Question (Medicine): 'Mummy Pig brings cookies for patient George! What are the cookies for?'
Options: 'A) They are his medicine to feel better 🍪💊 B) They are toys 🧸'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'They are his medicine to make him feel better!'

stopPoints.label: Doctor Peppa examines Daddy Pig's sore tummy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Checkup): 'Daddy Pig says he has a sore tummy! What is Doctor Peppa checking?'
Options: 'A) Daddy's tummy 🩺 B) Daddy's feet 🦶'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'She is checking Daddy's tummy!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa diagnoses that Daddy Pig is just hungry
stopPoints.question:
Question (Diagnosis): 'Peppa hears Daddy's tummy rumbling! What is wrong with Daddy?'
Options: 'A) He is very hungry! 😋 B) He has a cold 🤧'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'I think you're hungry, Daddy!'

stopPoints.label: The plate is empty as everyone eats cookies together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Ending): 'Daddy needs cookies to make him better too! Did everyone enjoy the cookies?'
Options: 'A) Yes, they ate all the cookies! 🍪😋 B) No, nobody ate them ❌'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they ate all the cookies!'
